idea-plugin.name: Maven For Search
idea-plugin.description:
Maven For Search / Maven 搜索

English

Search Maven Central artifacts directly from IntelliJ IDEA, with an experience similar to central.sonatype.com.

  • Smart search: exact match first, then tokenized fuzzy match (e.g. "spring-boot-web-starter" finds "spring-boot-starter-web")
  • Real-time latest version via repo1.maven.org maven-metadata.xml (no index delay)
  • View all historical versions with filter and double-click to copy XML
  • Copy Maven dependency XML to clipboard
  • Download jar to project lib/ directory (configurable)
  • Add dependency to pom.xml (configurable)
  • Tool Window + Shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+M) + Tools menu

中文说明

在 IntelliJ IDEA 中直接搜索 Maven Central 仓库构件, 体验接近 central.sonatype.com。

  • 智能搜索: 精确匹配优先, 分词模糊匹配补充 (例如输入 "spring-boot-web-starter" 可找到 "spring-boot-starter-web")
  • 通过 repo1.maven.org 的 maven-metadata.xml 获取实时最新版本 (无索引延迟)
  • 查看所有历史版本, 支持过滤, 双击复制 XML 并自动关闭弹窗
  • 复制 Maven dependency XML 到剪贴板
  • 下载 jar 到项目 lib/ 目录 (可配置)
  • 添加依赖到 pom.xml (可配置)
  • 提供 Tool Window + 快捷键 (Ctrl+Shift+M) + Tools 菜单三种入口

Usage / 使用方式

  • Tool Window: Click "Maven For Search" icon on the right toolbar / 点击右侧工具栏 "Maven For Search" 图标
  • Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+M / 快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+M
  • Menu: Tools → Maven For Search / 菜单: Tools → Maven For Search
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.6
- Fix: Version dialog now shows publish date for all versions, including latest ones missing from Solr index (parallel HEAD requests to Maven Central for Last-Modified timestamps) / 修复: 版本弹窗所有版本都显示发布日期, 包括 Solr 索引缺失的最新版本 (并行 HEAD 请求 Maven Central 补充 Last-Modified 时间戳)
- Fix: Resource leak in HEAD requests (HttpURLConnection.disconnect moved to finally block) / 修复: HEAD 请求资源泄漏 (HttpURLConnection.disconnect 移入 finally 块)
- Fix: Cancel pending CompletableFuture on timeout to avoid wasted background work / 修复: 超时后取消未完成的 CompletableFuture, 避免资源浪费

1.0.5
- Fix: Search results no longer get cleared after closing version dialog (stale async callbacks are now discarded via generation tag) / 修复: 关闭版本弹窗后搜索结果不再被清空 (通过 generation 标记丢弃过期异步回调)
- Fix: Rapid typing now always shows results for the last query (debounced requests ordered by generation, no stale overwrites) / 修复: 快速连续输入时始终展示最后一次查询的结果 (按 generation 排序, 不再被旧请求覆盖)
- Perf: Version dialog loads faster (parallel metadata + Solr gav requests, Solr capped at 3s for timestamps) / 性能: 版本弹窗加载更快 (并行请求 metadata 和 Solr, Solr 仅 3 秒超时用于补充时间戳)
- Fix: Enter key now reliably triggers immediate search (bound via InputMap/ActionMap instead of keyListener) / 修复: 回车键可靠触发立即搜索 (改用 InputMap/ActionMap 绑定)
- Fix: Sonatype API failure now properly falls back to Solr in AUTO_FALLBACK mode (no longer swallows exceptions) / 修复: AUTO_FALLBACK 模式下 Sonatype 失败正确回退到 Solr (不再吞异常)

1.0.4
- Fix: Infinite scroll now triggers on mouse wheel (removed valueIsAdjusting filter that blocked wheel events) / 修复: 无限滚动能响应鼠标滚轮 (移除误过滤滚轮事件的 valueIsAdjusting 判断)
- Fix: Version list shows real publish date per version (Solr gav first, metadata fallback without date) / 修复: 版本列表恢复显示每版本真实发布日期 (Solr gav 优先, metadata 回退无日期)

1.0.3
- Feat: Version dialog double-click now copies XML, closes dialog, and shows a notification / 新增: 版本弹窗双击复制 XML 并自动关闭, 弹出"已复制到剪贴板"提示
- Feat: Search results use infinite scroll instead of pagination buttons / 新增: 搜索结果改为无限滚动, 移除翻页按钮
- Fix: Version list no longer shows incorrect same date for all versions / 修复: 版本列表不再对所有版本显示同一个错误的日期
- Fix: Solr paging offset now correctly calculated (page * rows) / 修复: Solr 分页偏移量计算错误

1.0.2
- Fix: Smart search now finds artifacts regardless of token order (e.g. "spring-boot-web-starter" finds "spring-boot-starter-web") / 修复: 智能搜索支持词序无关匹配
- Fix: Version dialog loads correctly with fallback to search API / 修复: 版本对话框加载失败时自动回退到搜索 API
- Feat: Dual-query strategy (exact + fuzzy) with merged deduplicated results / 新增: 双查询策略 (精确+模糊) 合并去重
- Feat: Version list pagination (50 per page) / 新增: 版本列表分页 (每页 50 条)
- Feat: Bilingual plugin description (English + Chinese) / 新增: 中英双语插件描述

1.0.1
- Fix: search results lost when metadata enrichment times out
- Fix: Version viewer dialog now loads versions correctly
- Feat: double-click search result to view all versions
- Feat: version filter search in version dialog
- Feat: Enter key to search immediately
- Feat: real-time latest version via maven-metadata.xml
- UI: icons on buttons, zebra striping, better spacing

1.0.0
Initial release / 初始版本
